ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which population would increase if the water beetle population increased?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a food web, with Algae at the bottom, and an arrow from Algae pointing to Water Beetle; there is also an arrow from Water Beetle pointing to Frog. The image also shows Snail also pointing to Frog, and Frog pointing to Kingfisher. Reasoning: According to the convention in food webs that arrows point from food/prey to predator, Water Beetle is food for Frog. If the number of water beetle increases, frog can obtain more food, therefore frog population will increase.
